rule.name: Raw SQL via text() with String Concatenation
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a database query or query-construction operation. Determine whether untrusted values can change statement structure and whether record access is authorized.
rule.vuln_desc: If externally controlled values enter query syntax, an attacker may read, change, or delete records or bypass data-access restrictions with the database connection’s privileges. Fixed queries and correctly bound parameters do not establish this condition.
rule.developer: Bind data values as parameters, choose dynamic identifiers from a fixed allowlist, and enforce object-level access checks. Trace the complete query construction before replacing a safe query.
rule.reviewer: Confirm all text() calls use bound parameters and no user input is concatenated into the SQL string. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: filter() with Raw String Condition
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a database query or query-construction operation. Determine whether untrusted values can change statement structure and whether record access is authorized.
rule.vuln_desc: If externally controlled values enter query syntax, an attacker may read, change, or delete records or bypass data-access restrictions with the database connection’s privileges. Fixed queries and correctly bound parameters do not establish this condition.
rule.developer: Bind data values as parameters, choose dynamic identifiers from a fixed allowlist, and enforce object-level access checks. Trace the complete query construction before replacing a safe query.
rule.reviewer: Verify filter() arguments are ORM column expressions, not raw strings with user input. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Hardcoded Database Connection String
rule.rule_desc: The checked source or build configuration embeds potentially sensitive credential or key material. Determine whether it is active and whether it reaches distributed artifacts or logs.
rule.vuln_desc: A party who can read exposed source, artifacts, configuration, or logs may recover active secrets and access the protected service or decrypt data with the secret owner’s privileges.
rule.developer: Remove active secrets from source and build layers, rotate exposed values, and load replacements through a restricted secret-management facility. Use narrowly privileged, short-lived credentials.
rule.reviewer: Confirm no connection strings contain literal credentials. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: execute() with String Formatting
rule.rule_desc: The code constructs a query, selection, or ordering clause with values that may be externally controlled. Resolve whether those values enter syntax or bound data.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled query syntax may change selected records, bypass intended filters, or modify stored data with the connection or provider’s privileges.
rule.developer: Bind data values using the query API’s parameter mechanism. Choose ordering columns and other identifiers from a fixed allowlist, and enforce record-level authorization.
rule.reviewer: Verify all execute() calls use parameterized queries. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
